## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`cargo test`) and the book builds (`mdbook build docs`).
- [ ] The [support matrix](support-matrix/matrix.toml) is updated if the change touches a board, sensor driver, firmware wiring or hardware result (then run `cargo run -p rohi-support-matrix -- render --write`).
- [ ] The SDK book is updated if the change touches public behaviour (see `docs/contributing/docs-style.md`).
